questions.question: How long does it take to create a video on VidyBack?
questions.answer: Just a few minutes and voilà — your business is set to transform real-time data into video magic!

questions.question: Do I have to connect my social accounts every time I post?
questions.answer: Once your account is integrated, it will be saved for future postings. You have the option to remove your social account at any time.

questions.question: What kind of business does VidyBack support?
questions.answer: We provide support for e-commerce and online businesses, assisting with selling products and services.

questions.question: I don't have a website yet, can I still use it?
questions.answer: Yes. VidyBack integrates with platforms like Shopify, Etsy, and Jumpseller and many more.

questions.question: Can I link my Shopify or another eCommerce store?
questions.answer: VidyBack offers real-time store data to help you easily create product content, allowing you to focus on running your business while we manage your social marketing.

questions.question: Do I have ownership of the content I create?
questions.answer: A video generated by VidyBack AI is your property and includes a lifetime license for unlimited use and sharing.

questions.question: Is it possible for me to include my brand details, logo and color scheme?
questions.answer: Yes. Add your branding suite with your logo and store link, so every generated post reflects your identity.

questions.question: How many templates do you have to choose from?
questions.answer: Over 100 templates are available, with new ones added regularly.

questions.question: How many credits does it cost to create a post?
questions.answer: Each post creation with AI assistance uses exactly 10 credits, regardless of which AI features are used during the process.

questions.question: How many credits do I get?
questions.answer: Non-PRO users receive 50 credits per month. PRO users receive 1,000 credits per month. Credits refresh automatically at the start of each billing cycle.

questions.question: Can I begin at no cost? What options do you offer?
questions.answer: You can select the PRO (monthly) plan or the Premium (yearly) plan. There is also a Free plan with limited features for all users.

questions.question: How can I cancel my subscription?
questions.answer: Subscriptions can be cancelled anytime through app.vidyback.com under Account → Settings → Subscription → Manage Subscription. The account is then downgraded to the Free plan.

questions.question: What is VidyBack's refund policy?
questions.answer: VidyBack offers a full refund within 15 days of payment. Refund requests can be sent to support@vidyback.com. Approved refunds are processed within 10 business days.
